svg.title: Aggregated vs PD over TCP, fixed-shape sweep
svg.desc: Small-multiple line charts comparing aggregated serving and PD over TCP across concurrency 1, 4, 8 and 16 on four fixed shapes for ITL p99 (ms, linear), TTFT p50 (ms, log scale) and output throughput (tok/s, linear). PD holds ITL p99 below 19 ms and eliminates long-prompt concurrency-16 spikes (458.058 to 17.895 ms on 4096/128; 509.188 to 18.315 ms on 8192/128). Aggregated serving leads TTFT p50 in 15 of 16 cells (exception: 512/256 concurrency 8, where PD p95 still worsens) and leads output throughput in 15 of 16 cells (exception: 256/1024 concurrency 16, where aggregated includes an unresolved TTFT outlier).
svg.text: MODEL DEPLOYMENT · PD BENCHMARK · TCP BASELINE
Aggregated vs PD over TCP, fixed-shape sweep
Qwen3-32B BF16 on one 8 × H100 SXM5 node; six serving GPUs per configuration, TP = 2 per replica.
Shape = target input tokens / requested output tokens. One pass per configuration; concurrency 1, 4 and 8 used 32 measured requests, concurrency 16 used 64.
All 16 cells completed with zero errors in both configurations. KV moved over TCP with MooncakeConnector; no RDMA resources were allocated.
